body: BLOCK exact c6587336e131a88a9b21d703532fdc6c037a2bd4 after canonical object became reachable. I independently confirm the primary review's build integration regression. Relative to its exact parent 6ad95c5, changed build.sbt removes onnxRuntimeV and djlV, removes embedOnnx from root aggregation and jvmOnlyModules, deletes the entire embedOnnx project definition plus its fork/ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY gate, and removes embedOnnx from embedBench dependencies and the bench fork/telemetry settings, while the candidate tree still contains the landed embed-onnx source/test/model assets. This silently removes an existing module from compileAll/testAll/testJVM, so the emitted 15-module reference scope can pass precisely because it consults the regressed candidate build. Required successor: additive providerParser wiring on top of the complete 6ad95c5 build; preserve all embedOnnx pins, project definition, aggregation, embedBench dependency, fork/telemetry settings, and jvmOnlyModules entry; rerun reference-scope and the resulting gate. I did not broaden this block into parser-contract claims; the previously reviewed checksum fix and tool bytes can be carried unchanged but must be reverified in the additive successor. No authorization or landing claim.
